easyPrerequisites: Raise Dead must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Raise Dead using the convoke ability from Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Cheerful Osteomancer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Cheerful Osteomancer, which enters prepared.
Resolve Raise Dead.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
